strings.name: Martin Scorsese
strings.summary: Raised in New York’s Italian-American community and trained at NYU, Scorsese explores violence, faith, identity and American society in Mean Streets, Taxi Driver and Raging Bull. His work relies on sustained collaboration with performers, editors and cinematographers. The Departed earned him the directing Oscar; he also founded The Film Foundation to support international restoration and preservation.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Expanded American auteur cinema through works including Taxi Driver and has long promoted restoration and preservation of world cinema heritage.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Queens, New York City, United States.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Film studies at New York University; master’s degree (1968).
strings.highlights.h1.title: American auteur cinema
strings.highlights.h1.text: Develops personal expression through crime, psychological and historical films.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Film heritage preservation
strings.highlights.h2.text: Founded The Film Foundation in 1990 to support archives and restoration.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Killers of the Flower Moon
strings.timeline.t1.text: Directed a historical film about the Osage murders.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Directing Oscar
strings.timeline.t2.text: Won Best Director for The Departed.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Founded The Film Foundation
strings.timeline.t3.text: Joined film-industry partners to support preservation and restoration.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Raging Bull
strings.timeline.t4.text: Explored violence and self-destruction through boxer Jake LaMotta.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Taxi Driver
strings.timeline.t5.text: Directed the New York psychological film, which won Cannes’ Palme d’Or.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Mean Streets
strings.timeline.t6.text: Portrayed crime, loyalty and faith in Italian-American New York.
strings.timeline.t7.title: NYU master’s completed
strings.timeline.t7.text: Finished graduate film training and later taught at NYU.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in New York
strings.timeline.t8.text: Grew up in an Italian-American family; childhood filmgoing influenced his work.
